title: Non Traumatic Neuro-Vascular Diseases Critical Complications : a Prospective Cohort Study
official: Prospective Cohort of Patients Hospitalized in West French Intensive Care Units.
summary: The purpose of this observational epidemiological study is to investigate the management and the complications associated with Non Traumatic Neuro-Vascular Diseases. Data will be analysed to answer pre-defined scientific projects and to improve management of these conditions.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Non Traumatic Neuro-Vascular Diseases

Exclusion Criteria:

* Consent withdrawal
